title: docs(adr): ADR-0150 records the `?callerPackage=` caller arm (D5 row, D3 caller note, ADR-0149 D2 cross-reference)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xH354DdDD45W1vbmbvGXz2Q)_

Fixes #32362

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates --tier` reads a mandatory contract-review model tier for `docs/adr/**` (clause ①, effort floor xhigh, no one-line exit). That mandate is waived for card threads by the maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03): this card ran on the project's default model, and the dispatching seat (domain:skills#3) runs the contract review of record at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:在 ADR-0150 原地补记 #32337 已上线的 `?callerPackage=` 调用方参数:D5 门表加一行并附修订注(三个 dataset 门、400/409 拒绝、未安装读者按 `?package=ID` 应答、只读查询串);D3 (a) 加修订注(`?package=` 指持有者、不是调用方,`?callerPackage=` 指读者、是调用方,绝不回落到裸读);ADR-0149 D2 交叉引用写成条件式。
- 为什么改:ADR 仍写着"带包名的读取从不是调用方",作者和审查者在记录里找不到这个参数及其拒绝规则。
- 风险与回滚:只改一个 ADR 文件,+12/-0 行,不改代码、不发包;回滚即还原本 PR。每条门与拒绝都按 `main` 代码逐行核对,卡上说法在 `main` 上全部成立。
- 先看:D5 表新行和其下修订注(第 182–192 行),再看 D3 (a) 下的修订注(第 125 行)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs && pnpm check:adr-index && pnpm check:doc-authoring`,预期全部 exit 0;对照下方"Each door and refusal, checked on main"表抽查两三条源码行。
- 需要你做的:`check-governed-merges` 判为 **Tier H**(`docs/adr/**`),需 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 批准;当前 head 尚无席位契约复核 PASS,契约复核待做,请先不要批。

## What changes

`docs/adr/0150-behavioural-metadata-addressed-by-package-objects-keep-the-literal-prefix.md`, amended in place, in the ADR's own amendment-note style (dated blockquotes that name the card item):

1. **D5 door table:** a new row, "dataset caller arm", and an amendment note under the table. It names the three doors (`GET /meta/dataset/:name` on both transports, `POST /analytics/dataset/query`, `POST /analytics/dataset/query/batch`), `dataset` only by design, and the read as `?package=HOLDER` after resolution. Refusals: `400` beside `?package=` or on the qualified path; `400` for a blank, `all`, repeated or non-string value or a non-dataset type; on the batch, a malformed arm refuses the whole batch while a name's `409`/`404` is that query's entry; `409` when D3 refuses. An uninstalled reader gets the `?package=ID` answer, never the bare read. Query string only, never a header or the session.
2. **D3 (a) note:** the "never a caller" sentence holds for `?package=` (names the holder); `?callerPackage=` names the reader and is a caller, on the dataset doors only. ⛔ The arm is never a fallback to the bare read.
3. **ADR-0149 D2 cross-reference**, inside the D5 note, worded as **conditional**: #32292 is open (`pm:blocked` behind #32183) and has not landed on `main` at `c7dd505d`. On `main` the arm resolves before admission; once #32292 moves the dataset query door to admission first, the arm's D3 candidates become the admitted holders (none → `NOT_FOUND` byte-equal to a missing name, one → that one, two or more → `409` naming only those), per the epic note on #32292 (comment 6781265442).

### Beyond the card's list, recorded because `main` carries it

- `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` when the composed protocol or registry cannot resolve by caller (fail closed, never a bare read). The card does not list it; it is a server fault rather than a caller refusal, and the D3 note names it as one of the ways the arm never falls back.
- A name nothing holds is read at the reader's own address (its own miss).
- A well-formed arm beside an inline `dataset` body is not read (as `?package=` is not); a malformed one is still refused.

No card claim is false on `main`; there is no difference to report.

**Sweep:** `callerPackage` appears under `docs/`, `skills/`, `content/` and `.claude/` only in this ADR and `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` (written by #32337, consistent). No other ADR restates the "never a caller" sentence.

## The changed lines

D3 (a), inserted after line 124:

```diff
+  > **Amendment note (2026-11-11, #32362 item 2; the arm landed in PR #32337).** The sentence above holds for `?package=`, which names the HOLDER: it is the exact qualifier (D5), never a caller. `?callerPackage=P` names the READER: it is a caller, P, and the name resolves from P by this rule, steps 1–3 with (a) and (c) included, on the dataset doors only (D5's caller-arm row and its note). The two are never read together: sent on one read, they are refused `400`. ⛔ Under no circumstances is the arm a fallback to the bare read. `all`, a blank value and the arm beside `?package=` are refused `400`, a refusal of the rule is the `409`, a reader that is not installed is read as `?package=` naming it, and a deployment that cannot resolve by caller answers `503`.
```

D5, inserted after the connectors row (line 180): the new table row, then the amendment note.

```diff
+| dataset caller arm (D3; amendment note below) | `GET /meta/dataset/:name`, `POST /analytics/dataset/query` and `POST /analytics/dataset/query/batch`, each with `?callerPackage=P`: P is the reader's package, the name resolves from P by D3, and the holder is then read as `?package=HOLDER` | none: the qualified path `/meta/dataset/:ns/:name` refuses the arm `400` |
+
+> **Amendment note (2026-11-11, #32362 item 1; the arm landed in PR #32337).** `?callerPackage=P` names the package of the item that reads the name (a dashboard, report or chart of P). It is served on the three doors of the row above, `dataset` only, by design (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts#META_ITEM_CALLER_PACKAGE_TYPES`), and `GET /meta/dataset/:name` takes it on both transports (`RestServer` and the dispatcher). The name resolves from P by D3, and the door then reads the resolved holder at its exact address, `?package=HOLDER`, so the holder's bound overlay, drafts, lock and every read gate after it answer as that address answers (`#metaCallerPackageQuery`). Each refusal answers the same status and code on every door. The words come from three places: the arm's own refusals (a malformed value, the arm beside `?package=`, a type other than `dataset`) from `#metaItemCallerPackageRefusalMessage`, the qualified-path refusal from its own sentence in the two route files cited below, and a repeated value from the multiplicity sentence (`packages/rest/src/query-multiplicity.ts`):
+>
+> - **`400 VALIDATION_ERROR` for a second address:** the arm beside `?package=` (two addresses on one read, neither picked), and the arm on the qualified path `/meta/dataset/:ns/:name`, which is already exact (`packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`).
+> - **`400 VALIDATION_ERROR` for a malformed arm:** a blank value, `all` (which `?package=` reads as naming no package), a repeated or non-string value, or a type other than `dataset` on `/meta/:type/:name`. The batch door reads the arm once, from its URL, so a malformed arm refuses the whole batch before any query runs.
+> - **`409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` when D3 refuses**, naming the candidates (`ambiguous-in-closure`, `outside-closure`). On the batch door the name's resolution, its `409` and its `404` are that query's entry.
+>
+> A reader that is not an installed package (no registry entry, no residual owner) is read at its own address, so it gets exactly what `?package=ID` answers (`409` naming the holders, or the read's miss) and never the bare read (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts#resolveCallerPackageAddress`). A name nothing holds is read at P's own address too, which answers its own miss. The arm is read from the query string only, never from a header or the session. A deployment whose protocol or registry cannot resolve by caller fails closed with `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, never a bare read. A well-formed arm beside an inline `dataset` body is not read, as `?package=` is not; a refused one is refused all the same, whether malformed or beside `?package=` (a second address).
+>
+> **ADR-0149 D2 cross-reference (#32362 item 3; conditional: it applies once #32292 lands, which it has not on `main` at `c7dd505d`).** On `main` the arm resolves the name before admission, the order the bare read and `?package=` have on the dataset query door, so its `409` can name a holder the caller is not admitted to. ADR-0149 D2 has MCP `query_dataset` resolve a saved dataset as `list_datasets` would, with one `NOT_FOUND` for a missing and a hidden dataset. When #32292 moves the dataset query door to admission first, the arm moves with it: its D3 candidates are the holders the caller is admitted to; none admitted answers `NOT_FOUND`, byte-equal to a missing name; exactly one admitted answers that one; two or more answer `409` naming only those. Until then this paragraph describes no behaviour on `main`.
```
